Additional Information 
• Land Titles staff cannot legally provide any assistance in the completion of your caveat or tell you what your interest 
or grounds are. They can only review your caveat once completed and let you know if it is an acceptable interest for 
registration purposes only. 
 
The responsibility to ensure that the nature of the interest being claimed is sufficiently stated in the caveat lies with 
the registrant.
